what_this_is: Every lesson-body <jp> span that carries kanji and no `reading`, split into the ones a registry can settle (rows, applied) and the ones it cannot (residue, listed with both candidates and NOT applied). Keyed by (lesson, surface): one surface has one reading inside one lesson, which is also what makes the apply idempotent and exact-match.
